name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 5 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
